ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels estimated at 90-95% coverage, with localized high-intensity (white/light grey) punctate markings and clusters accounting for the remaining 5-10%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed white punctate markings scattered across the ventral surface; heavy white and brownish-red clustering at the distal tips of both lobes; linear light-grey mottling concentrated along the lower peduncle area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes; peaks show higher amplitude (3-5 pixels) near the median notch, tapering to high-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature extending from the central notch to the upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular white and reddish-brown pixel groups at the distal tips of both lobes, signifying sessile organism colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-aligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial region of the right-side (anatomical left) lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant textural and chromatic anomalies at the fluke tips consisting of white, beige, and reddish-brown protrusions consistent with barnacle growth and associated tissue scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a secondary fluke edge partially visible in the out-of-focus background at the top-center of the image frame.
